title: RNA Extraction and Depletion Protocol
author: Nils Weng
materials: Reagents and storage requirements for RNA depletion Stored in freezer: LA - Linear acrylamide RP - riboPOOL lyophilized,(aliquoted by user) RNAse inhbitor RiboLock (40u/µl) Stored in fridge : SMB - Streptavidin-coated magnetic beads (SMB) Stored in room temperature: DB - Depletion buffer HB - Hybridization buffer SA - Sodium acetate, 3M H2O - Nuclease-free water Reagents that has to be prepared in advance: BRB - Bead Resuspension Buffer 0,1 M NaOH 0.05M NaCl BWB - Bead Wash Buffer 0.1M NaCl

steps.title: Initial Preparations
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and reagents to prevent RNA degradation.

substeps.instruction: Chill centrifuge to 4°C.
Chill ethanol, Trizol LS, and chloroform at -20°C.
Clean workstation and equipment with ethanol and RNAse Away (or other RNAse decontamination solution).
Prepare a box of ice for samples.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Preparation
steps.instruction: Collect samples based on the sample type.

substeps.instruction: For pure or enrichment cultures: Take 3x50 ml samples into three 50ml falcon tubes while flushing with N2; keep on ice.
For anaerobic digester samples: Add 200-250 μl of sample to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm) and put on ice.
For anaerobic digester samples: Centrifuge in pre-cooled centrifuge at 4°C, 5500 RPM for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Lysis of the samples using Trizol and bead-beating.

substeps.instruction: For pure/enrichment cultures: Discard supernatant, put pellets on ice, and resuspend in 750 µl chilled Trizol LS (mix by pipette). Pool across three 50ml falcon tubes to ensure thorough mixing. Final volume of pellet + Trizol should be ≈ 1000µl (max 1400µl).
For anaerobic digester samples: Add 1 ml chilled TriZol Reagent (or 750 μL TriZol LS).
Transfer the mixed sample to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm).
Homogenize samples using a bead-beater at speed 6.0 for 40 seconds.
Transfer up to 800 μl of the mixture into a Zymo-Spin™ IIICG Column in a 2.5 ml Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 5,000 x g for 60 seconds; save the flow-through.
Add an equal volume of 95-100% ethanol (1:1) to the flow-through and mix well.
Transfer the mixture into a new Zymo-Spin™ IIICG Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge (10,000-16,000 rcf, 30 seconds); discard flow-through.
Add 400 µl RNA Prep Buffer to the column and centrifuge (10,000-16,000 rcf, 30 seconds); discard flow-through.
Transfer the column into a nuclease-free tube, add 100 µl DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the matrix, and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 5,000 rcf.

steps.title: RNA Filtration and Binding
steps.instruction: Filter the RNA and bind it to a new column.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filter in a Collection Tube by adding 600 µl Prep Solution and centrifuging at 8,000 x g for 4 minutes (or 3 minutes per technical note).
Transfer the eluted RNA from the previous step into the prepared filter and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 4 minutes.
Add 200 µl RNA Binding Buffer to the filtered RNA (2:1 ratio) and mix well.
Add an equal volume (approx 300 µL) of 95-100% ethanol (1:1) and mix well.
Transfer the mixture into a new Zymo-Spin™ IC Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge (10,000-16,000 rcf, 30 seconds); discard flow-through.

steps.title: DNase I Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the bound RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge (10,000-16,000 rcf, 30 seconds), and discard flow-through.
Prepare DNase I Reaction Mix: 35 µl DNA Digestion Buffer and 5 µl DNase I per sample; mix by gentle inversion.
Add 40 µl of the DNase I Reaction Mix to the column matrix and incubate at room temperature (20-30°C) for 15 minutes.

steps.title: RNA Purification and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash and elute the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl RNA Prep Buffer to the column and centrifuge (10,000-16,000 rcf, 30 seconds); discard flow-through.
Add 700 µl RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge (10,000-16,000 rcf, 30 seconds); discard flow-through.
Add 400 µl RNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge for 1 minute (10,000-16,000 rcf) to ensure complete removal of buffer.
Transfer the column into a nuclease-free tube.
Add 15 µl DNase/RNase-Free Water (volume can be varied, ≥ 6 µl for high concentration) directly to the matrix, incubate for 2 minutes, and centrifuge (10,000-16,000 rcf, 30 seconds).

steps.title: Initial Quality Control
steps.instruction: Check RNA quality using Agilent Bioanalyzer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer: Fill one electrode cleaner well with 350 µl RNaseZAP, place in Bioanalyzer for 1 minute, then remove. Fill another well with 350 µl RNase-free water, place in Bioanalyzer for 10s, then remove and dry for 10s.
Analyze 1 µl of eluted RNA using the 'Prokaryote Total RNA Nano Series II' assay.

steps.title: rRNA Hybridization
steps.instruction: Hybridize riboPOOL to rRNA for depletion.

substeps.instruction: To 14 μl of RNA sample (100 ng - 5 μg total RNA), add 1 µL resuspended RP, 5 µL Hybridization Buffer (HB), and RNase inhibitor (RiboLock) to a final concentration of 1 U/μl (e.g., 0.5μl RiboLock for 20 μl total volume). If sample > 14 μl, adjust HB to 0.25X total volume (max 40 μl).
Briefly centrifuge to spin down droplets.
Incubate at 68°C for 10 minutes to denature RNA.
Turn off heat block and allow the sample to cool naturally from 68°C to 37°C.
Resuspend SMB by vortexing at medium speed.
Transfer 90 μl bead suspension into a fresh tube (or aliquot for multiple samples: 540 μl for 6, 1080 μl for 12).
Place tube on magnetic rack for 1 minute.
Aspirate and discard all supernatant while keeping the tube on the rack.
Add 80 μl Depletion Buffer (DB) per sample, agitate to resuspend, place on magnetic rack for 1 minute, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: rRNA Depletion
steps.instruction: Capture rRNA using the prepared beads.

substeps.instruction: Combine 80 µl of prepared beads with ~20 μl of the hybridized riboPOOL-RNA solution and agitate.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes, followed by 50°C for 5 minutes.
Briefly spin down droplets and place on magnetic rack for 2 minutes.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new tube (use kit-provided tubes for visible pellet).
Optional: Place the new tube on the magnetic rack for 1 minute to remove trace beads and transfer supernatant to another tube.

steps.title: Final RNA Precipitation and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Precipitate and wash the depleted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µl of 3M sodium acetate (SA), 1 µl of Linear acrylamide (LA), and 333 µl of 100% ethanol to the RNA solution; vortex well.
Incubate at -80°C for 30 minutes OR -20°C overnight.
Centrifuge at 11,000 x g (or max speed) for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully remove and discard all supernatant.
Add 200 μl of 70% ethanol to wash the pellet.
Carefully remove and discard all supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash step.
Dry the pellet at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 11,000 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully remove and discard all supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 32 μl (or desired volume down to 10 µl) of nuclease-free water or elution buffer.
Decontaminate electrodes using 350 µl RNaseZAP and 350 µl RNase-free water as described in the initial QC step.
Analyze 1 µl of dissolved RNA using the 'mRNA Nano Series II' assay.
